source.captured_by: owner screenshots (in-chat upload, not committed to repo)
source.note: Values OCR'd from in-game inventory screenshots. Top-bar and tooltip-confirmed values are high confidence; icon-identified currencies and the dense material/charm grids are flagged in needs_verification. The Crafting Materials and Enhancement Ingredients tabs contain hundreds of per-set/per-stat tiles the game only names one-at-a-time, so those are summarized, not itemized — see needs_verification.

covenant_bookmarks_limited.note: tooltip 'Covenant Bookmarks' with a 15d expiry timer — a time-limited event stack, tracked separately from the permanent 217

stigma.note: owner-confirmed (red fox icon); also the leftmost top-bar value on the Forest of Souls screen

currency_grid_unlabeled.note: Remaining Currency-tab tiles: counts reliable, identity not yet confirmed by the owner. Owner labeled the high-value ones (see currencies above); these are the leftovers. Owner can tap any tile in-game to name it if a specific one is ever needed.

crafting_materials.note: Hunt set-crafting materials (Crafting Materials tab). The set 'molecule' tiles (blue crystals with element+set badges) number in the hundreds of distinct set x element x grade combos; counts are legible but per-tile identity is not OCR-reliable, so only the named/high-count anchors are recorded. Ask for a targeted re-capture if session 5/6 needs a specific set's craft stock.

bulk_material_anchors.note: Top-row Crafting Materials values (identity by icon, unverified): purple-swirl 5802, red-feather 636, black-ore 54562, teal-claw 278155, grey-molecule 5.

set_molecule_grid.note: Present in large quantity across ~5 screens; individual set/element/grade tiles NOT itemized (OCR icon-ID unreliable). Re-capture per-set if needed.

epic_artifact_charm.note: tooltip-confirmed 'Epic Artifact Charm — for granting incredible strength to Artifacts'

gear_charm_grid.note: The Enhancement Ingredients tab holds hundreds of gear charm tiles (stat x set x element, counts mostly 1-12). Counts legible; per-tile identity not OCR-reliable. These feed gear crafting/mod decisions — re-capture specific stat charms if session 5 needs them.

growth_ingredients.note: Growth Ingredients tab (skill-ups, awakening, hero XP). MolaGora is tooltip+owner confirmed; other tiles (spirit blooms, penguins/fodder, hunt skill-up catalysts) are counts-only — legible but per-tile identity not OCR-reliable. Ask for a specific catalyst on demand.

spirit_bloom_anchors.note: Awakening blooms by icon (unverified): purple-lotus 229 (Superior?), gold-lotus 1000 (Greater?), white-flower 4426 (basic Spirit Bloom).

other_growth_grid.note: Penguins/fodder (top-left ~9/12/27), elemental awakening stones, and hunt skill-up catalysts present in quantity; not itemized.

forest_of_souls.note: Building/sanctuary upgrades were PATCHED OUT (owner-confirmed 2026-08-12). Forest of Souls now only runs timed farms (Penguin Nest, Spirit Well, MolaGora Farm) — these are cooldowns, not stock, so no levels to record.

artifacts_owned.note: Spare/owned artifact catalog from the Artifact tab (16 screens, 194/400 slots used). Best-effort OCR: names high confidence, per-copy enhancement/count MEDIUM. max_plus = highest enhancement seen; count = copies visible. Equipped artifacts are also in the Fribbels export; this list is the full owned set incl. spares.

A long tail of single-copy low-enhancement event artifacts (tarot cards, cookies, seasonal) was seen but not exhaustively transcribed. Ask for a full itemization if you want every spare recorded.
